text: dsh-stats-hud 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的科幻风会话统计 HUD。它作为浏览器侧插件接入 composer dock，在页面右侧固定显示，不替换原有统计行。面板汇总步骤与回合数、LLM 和工具耗时比例、每秒令牌吞吐量、上下文占用及缓存命中情况，并以滚动计数器呈现令牌变化。窗口空间不足时会切换为精简视图，窄于 800 像素时隐藏。适合希望在 DSH 对话中持续查看运行和令牌指标的用户；插件读取 DSH 提供的会话投影数据，不需要额外 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-stats-hud adds a sci-fi HUD to the DeepSeek Harness web interface. It shows session steps, turns, model and tool time, token throughput, context occupancy and cache hits beside the chat. The panel adapts to available space and reads DSH session data; no extra API key is needed.
想在 DSH 对话旁边实时查看步骤、回合和令牌用量。
需要一个固定在网页右侧的会话统计仪表板。
想同时比较模型生成和工具调用分别花了多少时间。
希望查看上下文窗口占用比例以及系统提示、工具和消息的令牌明细。
How can I see live token throughput and cache-hit rates during a DSH session?
I need a compact session stats panel that adjusts to the space beside my chat.
dsh-stats-hud 的功能「展示会话步骤与回合计数」：面板显示步骤和回合数，并用滚动数字呈现变化。 面板从 DSH 会话和投影数据读取指标；空间不足时会切换精简显示。
dsh-stats-hud 的功能「比较 LLM 与工具耗时」：双段条按 LLM 和工具耗时比例展示两类时间。 面板从 DSH 会话和投影数据读取指标；空间不足时会切换精简显示。
dsh-stats-hud 的功能「查看吞吐量、上下文与缓存指标」：仪表显示 tokens/s、上下文窗口占用及分段明细、缓存命中率和令牌计数。 面板从 DSH 会话和投影数据读取指标；空间不足时会切换精简显示。
DSH 有没有办法把上下文使用情况放在聊天旁边？

**English** · [**简体中文**](README-CN.md)

dsh-stats-hud README · dsh-stats-hud：A sci-fi HUD for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): the session's stats become game-style level bars in a **vertical column fixed to the far right edge** of the web UI — without touching the original stats line.

> **Install:** in the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste `https://github.com/lauytgary/dsh_hud_plugin`, press **Install**, then **Enable now**. [Full instructions ↓](#install)

dsh-stats-hud README · Upgrading from an older DSH：After DSH moved to declaration-gated slots (`0.1.2-rc.1`), an install of this
plugin made *before* that change fails at startup with:

```
Failed to load plugins
dsh-stats-hud
failed to apply loader entry … (dsh-stats-hud): slot "conversation.composer.dock" is not declared (a parent entry's children table must declare it)
```

Update the plugin to the fixed version (the 2026-09-08 Changelog entry above), then reload it:

dsh-stats-hud README · Upgrading from an older DSH：- **Installed from a local checkout** (`link:` dependency): update the
  checkout (`git pull`, or copy the new files over). The client half is
  hot-reloaded by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` into the running page; restart
  the host (the Desktop app or `dsh web`) only if the plugin's host half or its
  `cordis.patch.yml` patch changed.
- **Installed from GitHub or npm**: re-resolve the latest version with
  `dsh plugin --profile <profile> update dsh-stats-hud`, or `remove` and `add` the
  package again, then **restart the host** — a newly resolved install path is
  composed at boot.

dsh-stats-hud README · Upgrading from an older DSH：Quick sanity check that the fixed version is in place: the client code must
contain the new registration pattern `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.composer.dock", …)` (see `lib/client.js`).

If the alert still shows after the restart, hard-refresh the browser page
(`Cmd+Shift+R`) — the plugin's browser bundle is cached per page load.

dsh-stats-hud README · Instruments (all-English, LLM terminology)：| Instrument | Data | Full scale | Past full scale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CLOCK` badge | Local time (24h) + `DS API PEAK` / `DS API OFF PEAK` rate | Peak = Mon–Fri Beijing 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 (i.e. Mon–Fri 01:00-04:00 / 06:00-10:00 UTC); weekends and all other hours are OFF-PEAK (half price) | PEAK orange tint, OFF-PEAK green tint |
| `STEPS / TURN` rolling rows | Steps / turns as odometer drums (like the CONTEXT rows) | — | Drums spin up on mount, roll on change |
| `LLM / TOOLS` dual bar | Two columns (labels over values), bar segments = raw LLM:TOOLS time ratio | No cap — 2:1 time means 2:1 bar | — |
| `THROUGHPUT` gauge | tokens/s (throughput), centered title, combined centered readout (`146 tok/s`) | Redline auto-scales 200→300→400… (arc ticks follow) | — |
| `CONTEXT USAGE` bar | Context-window usage % with 3 segments: Sys Prompt (gray) / Tools (blue) / Messages (purple) by token ratio | 0-100% | ≥80% whole bar turns solid red; hover shows the three token counts |
| `CACHE HIT` bar | Cache-hit % | 0-100% | <50% red, <80% yellow, ≥80% green |
| `CONTEXT` rolling counter | Three odometer rows: CACHE

dsh-stats-hud README · Instruments (all-English, LLM terminology)：While the agent is running the whole panel breathes and bars pulse.

Hovering the `CONTEXT USAGE` bar pops up a tooltip with the token breakdown:

dsh-stats-hud README · Responsive layout：The HUD adapts to the free space right of the chat column (measured live with a ResizeObserver, so sidebar drags, the details drawer and window resizes all count):

| Tier | Condition | Shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `full` | Window ≥ 800px and free space ≥ 180px | Everything |
| `mini` | Window ≥ 800px and free space < 180px | Clock (short PEAK/OFF PEAK badge) + compact rolling rows (Step/Turn/HIT/MISS/OUT) |
| `hidden` | Window < 800px | Nothing (element stays mounted, `display:none`) |

dsh-stats-hud README · Responsive layout：The window width is a hard floor: below 800px the panel hides even with room to spare, and only the measured space decides `full` vs `mini` (the full panel needs 164px + 12px margin). `mini` may slightly overlap the chat on narrow windows — safe because the panel is click-through. If the chat column can't be measured, the panel falls back to `full`.

dsh-stats-hud README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `dsh` **0.2.1-rc.5** (macOS; the Desktop app's bundled runtime). Slot registration is declaration-gated, so the plugin registers through the `ctx.slots.inject(...)` pattern — see Changelog
- pnpm (for plugin management)

dsh-stats-hud README · Desktop app (recommended)：1. Open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar and press **Add plugin**.
2. Pick **Install a third-party plugin** and paste one of these:

| Spec | Example |
   | --- | --- |
   | Git address | `https://github.com/lauytgary/dsh_hud_plugin` |
   | Local checkout | `/absolute/path/to/dsh-stats-hud` |
   | npm package | `dsh-stats-hud` (not published yet) |

dsh-stats-hud README · Desktop app (recommended)：3. Press **Install**, let pnpm finish, then press **Enable now**.
4. The HUD appears at the far right of the conversation right away — no restart, no page refresh.

The card under **Plugins → Installed** always shows the spec it was installed from, so a local checkout (`link:`) is the easiest way to keep up: `git pull` and the client half hot-reloads.

dsh-stats-hud README · Command line：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/lauytgary/dsh_hud_plugin
```

dsh-stats-hud README · Command line：Use `--profile desktop` for the Desktop app and `web` for a `dsh web` profile. The command installs the dependency **and** selects the bundle, but a running host only composes it at boot: **restart the host** afterwards (refresh the page after a `dsh web` restart). A local path installs as a `link:` dependency, so editing `lib/client.js` never needs a reinstall — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` re-applies the plugin in the running page.

dsh-stats-hud README · Check that it works：- **Plugins → Installed** lists `dsh-stats-hud` with its switch on:

- The HUD column sits at the far right edge of the window once the session has recorded a step.

dsh-stats-hud README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| No HUD at all | It hides while the session has no steps/tokens, and whenever the window is narrower than 800px |
| Installed but nothing shows | Turn its switch on under **Plugins → Installed** |
| The card shows an error | pnpm could not fetch the spec (GitHub unreachable, local path moved) — open the card and reinstall |
| Installed from the CLI | Restart the host: the CLI cannot recompose a running app |

dsh-stats-hud README · Uninstall：Open the card under **Plugins → Installed** and uninstall it there, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-stats-hud
```

dsh-stats-hud README · How it works：- Registers into the `conversation.composer.dock` slot (id `dsh-stats-hud`, order 1) — **only to receive the session-scoped hooks** (`useSession`/`useProjection`); the panel itself is `position: fixed`, takes no layout space, and the stock stats line stays untouched. Registration goes through `ctx.slots.inject(...)`, which waits for the slot to be declared by its parent entry (required since DSH made slot registration declaration-gated).
- Data comes from the same projections the stock UI uses: `useProjection("sessionStats")`, `useProjection("tokenUsage")`, `useProjection("contextPressure")` and `useProjection("contextBreakdown")` — zero host-side changes.
- `exports.inject = ["slots"]` is mandatory: DSH's ctx is a strict proxy, and reading any service not listed there throws (`service "slots" is not declared by your plugin`). The package-level `dsh.client` declaration needs no `inject` list — the bundle requires nothing but `react`.
- The panel is `pointer-events: none` (click-through); only the CONTEXT USAGE bar re-enables pointer events so its hover tooltip works.

dsh-stats-hud README · Files：```
dsh-stats-hud/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle (patch layer) + dsh.client (browser entry)
├── cordis.patch.yml      # inserts the plugin into loader entries
├── lib/

`lib/client.js` is a hand-written loader bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) — no build step needed.

dsh-stats-hud README · Development & testing：```sh
npm test   # pure-function unit tests (node:test, no dependencies; Node ≥ 18)
```

The tests load `lib/client.js` in a Node VM with a stubbed loader (no DOM
needed) and exercise the pure helpers — `formatTokens`, `formatDuration`,
`formatTps`, `tierOf`, `billedInputTokens`, `cacheHitPercent`, `isDsApiPeak`. The test-only
`__test` export is gated behind the `DSH_HUD_TEST` env var, so the browser
bundle is unaffected.

dsh-stats-hud README · Tuning：- Labels: the `L` object (all-English LLM terminology)
- Peak hours: `LocalClock` delegates to `isDsApiPeak(date)`, which checks the Beijing (UTC+8) weekday `bjDow >= 1 && bjDow <= 5` (Mon-Fri) together with `bjMin >= 540 && bjMin < 720` (9-12h) / `>= 840 && < 1080` (14-18h), where `bjMin`/`bjDow` come from `new Date(date.getTime() + 8*3600e3)` — weekends are always off-peak
- `MissionRolling`: rolling drums for steps/turns (no full scale)
- `ChannelBar`: segment ratio = `llmMs / (llmMs + toolMs)` (no cap)
- `SpeedGauge`'s `redline = 200` (initial; auto-scales in 100 tok/s steps)
- `ContextUsageBar`: segment colors and the ≥80% solid-red threshold; the hover tooltip reads `systemTokens` / `toolsTokens` / `messageTokens` from the `contextBreakdown` projection
- Rolling counter: `DRUM` (3× 0-9), `DRUM_H = 15` (px per digit), `RollingValue`'s carry/borrow formula and mount spin-up
